connector.name: DefectDojo
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for DefectDojo: 24 tools with RBAC, HMAC audit chain, and SIEM forwarding
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-defectdojo. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the inspicere account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DEFECTDOJO_URL
env.description: Base URL of the DefectDojo instance (must use https:// unless ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP=true)

env.name: DEFECTDOJO_API_KEY
env.description: API key for DefectDojo (generate at DefectDojo > API v2 > Your API Key). Use DEFECTDOJO_READ_API_KEY + DEFECTDOJO_WRITE_API_KEY for least-privilege dual-key mode.

env.name: DEFECTDOJO_READ_API_KEY
env.description: Optional read-only API key (used for GET requests in dual-key mode)

env.name: DEFECTDOJO_WRITE_API_KEY
env.description: Optional write API key (used for POST/PATCH in dual-key mode)

env.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token granting admin-role access (legacy single-token mode — prefer MCP_ROLE_<NAME>=<token>:<role> for RBAC)

env.name: AUDIT_HMAC_KEY
env.description: HMAC key for audit log integrity chain. Required for cross-restart log verification on network transports. Generate with: python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))'
